label: Harley is tied; Yvaine ties
from: Assumed the PAWGIE Assassin held the line
to: HARLEY HAS THE ROPE KINK AND IS THE ONE BOUND. YVAINE DOES THE TYING
note:
THE SPIN CYCLE FUCK runs on this direction and so does every rooftop chair. On 6 September Yvaine tied her wife in the middle of a lit rooftop with twenty women awake and the only person who noticed it happening was Harley.

THE FAN IS RATED FOR IT. Abbi forged the mounting hardware. Load-bearing, rope-rated, and the house recognises the thunk-whirr-thunk on sight.
